title: Sri Lanka country-guide research dossier

reportedFindings.claim: CBSL warns against forex trading, related remittances and profits.
reportedFindings.scope: “Person in, or resident in Sri Lanka”; online forex transactions.
reportedFindings.quote: “not permitted to undertake forex trading transactions or remit funds outside Sri Lanka…”
reportedFindings.limitations: Regulator notice. Product taxonomy and interaction with subsequent rules unresolved.

reportedFindings.claim: Notice also addresses promotion and reported losses.
reportedFindings.quote: “CBSL may take actions against both parties who encourage the public…”
reportedFindings.limitations: Regulator notice. Application to an offshore publisher/affiliate requires legal review.

reportedFindings.claim: Sri Lankan bank-issued cards cannot be used for forex trading.
reportedFindings.scope: EFTCs issued by banks in Sri Lanka.
reportedFindings.quote: “EFTCs shall not be used… Dealings in foreign exchange (Forex Trading)”
reportedFindings.limitations: Regulator guidance, FAQ 30. Does not establish permission for other channels.

reportedFindings.claim: Ordinary documented foreign payments are distinct.
reportedFindings.scope: Residents; goods, services, education and medical expenses.
reportedFindings.quote: “Residents may remit funds for the services obtained from a non-resident by producing required documents.”
reportedFindings.sourceDescription: Same DFE FAQ as L3, questions 1–4.  [dfe](https://www.dfe.lk/web/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=402&Itemid=742&lang=en)
reportedFindings.limitations: Regulator guidance. Not a permission for speculative brokerage deposits.

reportedFindings.claim: 2026 rules replaced 2021 overseas-capital regulations.
reportedFindings.quote: “is hereby rescinded, without prejudice to anything done thereunder.”
reportedFindings.sourceDescription: Government Gazette, hosted by DFE. `https://www.dfe.lk/web/images/rdevelopment/1e053526afc012cd3d06e03a8270234c-2493-36-E.pdf` — 18 June 2026; effective 20 June 2026.  [dfe](https://www.dfe.lk/web/images/rdevelopment/1e053526afc012cd3d06e03a8270234c-2493-36-E.pdf)
reportedFindings.limitations: Regulation, paragraph 2.1. Does not expressly repeal the forex notice.

reportedFindings.claim: Rupee-conversion category restricts individual investments.
reportedFindings.scope: Resident individuals excluding emigrants and non-nationals; paragraph 3.
reportedFindings.quote: “only in overseas Employee Share Ownership Plans or Employees Share Option Schemes.”
reportedFindings.limitations: Regulation. Do not generalize beyond its funding/category scope.

reportedFindings.claim: Existing foreign-assets/foreign-exchange provision needs interpretation.
reportedFindings.quote: “utilizing any foreign assets or foreign exchange held in a bank account…”
reportedFindings.limitations: Regulation. Does not expressly mention leveraged forex/CFDs; directions and other laws remain relevant.

reportedFindings.claim: Applicable section 22 orders retain effect.
reportedFindings.quote: “shall have effect during the period of such Order…”
reportedFindings.sourceDescription: Same Gazette as L5, paragraph 2.2. DFE index: `https://www.dfe.lk/web/index.php?option=com_rdevelopment&task=gazettes&Itemid=678` — displayed update 19 October 2026.  [dfe](https://www.dfe.lk/web/images/rdevelopment/1e053526afc012cd3d06e03a8270234c-2493-36-E.pdf)
reportedFindings.limitations: Regulation plus official index. Gazette 2493/38’s operative English text not accessed.

reportedFindings.claim: Residency extends beyond passport nationality.
reportedFindings.quote: “Sri Lankan citizens who live in foreign countries on student visas”
reportedFindings.limitations: Official summary. Underlying residency order and amendments not accessed.

reportedFindings.claim: Foreign licensing is not automatic host-country permission.
reportedFindings.scope: Seychelles securities dealers offering services elsewhere.
reportedFindings.quote: “must hold the required exemption, cross border agreement or relevant approval…”
reportedFindings.limitations: Regulator document. Does not determine a particular broker’s Sri Lankan status.

reportedFindings.claim: Enforcement is not guaranteed client recovery.
reportedFindings.quote: “does not extend to the remedy of any disgorgement, recuperation of funds or similar matters.”
reportedFindings.limitations: Regulator document. Do not promise recovery or compensation.

reportedFindings.claim: Official clarification contact.
reportedFindings.limitations: Official contact page. Email is JavaScript-obfuscated in retrieved text; do not claim it was read there.

reportedFindings.claim: Exness SC is listed as a securities dealer.
reportedFindings.quote: “Business Name: Exness (SC) Ltd”; “Type: Securities Dealer”
reportedFindings.limitations: Official register entry. Licence number not displayed in retrieved entry.

reportedFindings.claim: Exness states SD025 and distinguishes retail entities.
reportedFindings.quote: “Exness (SC) Ltd… license number SD025”; UK/Cyprus “does not offer services to retail clients.”
reportedFindings.limitations: Broker statement. No Sri Lankan entity allocation established.

reportedFindings.claim: Standard pricing and spread variability.
reportedFindings.quote: “From 0.2 pips”; “No commission”; “Spreads may fluctuate and widen…”
reportedFindings.limitations: Broker statement. Minimum deposit not extracted; not country-specific.

reportedFindings.claim: Platforms/protection claims are conditional research evidence.
reportedFindings.quote: “Swap-free trading is available if you have Swap-free status…”
reportedFindings.limitations: Broker statement. Protection exclusions and contract applicability not established.

reportedFindings.claim: Separate agreements/procedures exist.
reportedFindings.quote: “Complaints Procedure for Clients”
reportedFindings.limitations: Broker legal index. Index access is not access to underlying agreements.

reportedFindings.claim: XM Global claims Belize licence 8557558.
reportedFindings.quote: “under the Securities Industry Act 2021 (license number 8557558)”
reportedFindings.limitations: Broker statement. Direct Belize register confirmation not established.

reportedFindings.claim: A separate XM company appears on Seychelles register.
reportedFindings.quote: “Business Name: XM (SC) Limited”; “Trade Name: XMGlobal”
reportedFindings.limitations: Official register. Different company; no resident allocation or licence number established.

reportedFindings.claim: XM publishes minimum deposits and NBP claim.
reportedFindings.quote: “Minimum Deposit $5”; “All accounts offer negative balance protection”
reportedFindings.limitations: Broker statement. Contractual exclusions and Sri Lankan eligibility unverified.

reportedFindings.claim: XM accessible bonus PDF uses a different licence number.
reportedFindings.scope: XM Global Limited, bonus agreement only.
reportedFindings.quote: “License Number: 000261/309”; bonus “cannot be withdrawn.”
reportedFindings.limitations: Broker document. Number/address discrepancy; not full trading contract.

reportedFindings.claim: Raw Trading is officially listed.
reportedFindings.quote: “Type: Securities Dealer”; “IC Markets Global and IC MARKETS (SC)”
reportedFindings.limitations: Official register. Number SD018 not displayed in retrieved entry.

reportedFindings.claim: IC claims SD018, segregation, and warns of losses exceeding deposits.
reportedFindings.quote: “License NO SD018”; “losses may exceed the amount you have deposited.”
reportedFindings.limitations: Broker statement. Do not infer unconditional NBP.

reportedFindings.claim: Account pricing differs materially by account/platform.
reportedFindings.quote: Raw Spread: “$3.5($7.0 per lot round turn)”; Standard: “0.8” pips.
reportedFindings.limitations: Broker statement. Floors not averages; Pro products marked early access.

reportedFindings.claim: Funding charges may include third-party bank costs.
reportedFindings.quote: “may incur fees, such as intermediary fees”
reportedFindings.limitations: Broker statement. No Sri Lankan payment permission inferred.

reportedFindings.claim: Pepperstone Markets appears in official Bahamas register.
reportedFindings.quote: “Managing Capital Market Instruments and trading CFD’s”
reportedFindings.limitations: Official register. Identified entry accessed; licence number not shown in retrieved entry.

reportedFindings.claim: Pepperstone states SIA-F217 and entity-specific contracts.
reportedFindings.quote: “legal documents vary by Pepperstone entity and applicable regulation”
reportedFindings.limitations: Broker legal index. Operative client terms/complaints notice not accessed.

reportedFindings.claim: Pricing page contains mixed or conflicting details.
reportedFindings.scope: Footer: Pepperstone Markets Limited; page also references other jurisdictions.
reportedFindings.quote: “minimum you can add is $10”; overview “Min deposit $0”
reportedFindings.sourceDescription: Pepperstone. `https://pepperstone.com/en/trading/trading-accounts/` — no overall revision date; includes dated historical data.  [pepperstone](https://pepperstone.com/en/trading/trading-accounts/)
reportedFindings.limitations: Broker statement. TradingView and minimum-funding descriptions need reconciliation.

legalReviewQuestions: How do Gazette 2493/36, the current section 22 order, and implementing directions interact with CBSL’s forex notice?
Does paragraph 4 cover leveraged currency derivatives or CFDs, and under what product classifications and conditions?
Does the answer differ for currency CFDs, non-currency CFDs, futures, options, ordinary securities, or genuine commercial hedging?
What rules apply to existing foreign assets, foreign-currency accounts, previously authorized investments, and special permissions?
How should “in, or resident in Sri Lanka” apply to temporary visitors, overseas students, non-nationals, dual citizens, and emigrants?
What authorization, exemption, or approval would an offshore entity need to target or serve the relevant residents?
Does an informational broker comparison constitute encouragement in a particular context? How does the answer change with rankings, affiliate links, paid placements, or account-opening content?
Which complaint, litigation, arbitration, compensation, or insurance routes actually apply under the exact client contract?
What obligations arise for Devin Forex based on its own business location, target audience, affiliate contracts, and editorial conduct?
ownerEvidenceNeeded: Affiliate agreements: Executed agreement, contracting affiliate entity, active status, effective date.
Sri Lanka country-targeting permission: Written program approval addressing Sri Lankan traffic and permitted promotional activities.
Approved promotional wording: Required risk warnings, prohibited claims, creative-approval rules.
Actual broker-entity allocation: Dated written compliance confirmation identifying the entity and resident category; this still does not establish Sri Lankan legality.
Firsthand testing: Genuine records identifying tester, date, entity, platform, methodology, and limitations. No live testing is recommended as a way around unresolved restrictions.
Editorial methodology: Documented criteria, conflict controls, source-review procedure, correction process.
Authors/reviewers: Real identities, relevant qualifications, scope of review, consent to attribution.
Legal approval: Written qualified advice addressing the current instruments and the proposed page’s content/promotional scope.
Implementation evidence: Repository or screenshots showing that restricted-country controls actually suppress commercial links.
